anchor_rule: canonical (state_time_s, lap_number, driver_id) order via list_anchors; indices floor((total-1)*f) for f in [1/3, 2/3]; K=2 per race

categories: high-uncertainty (widest mean CI width over 6 deltas)
objective-tradeoff (max d_podium point subject to downside point > 0.02)
case_study_rule.rule: algorithmic rank on aggregate descriptors; no race names in rule

crn_experiment.independent_construction: same state/config/count with different master_seed per arm; unpaired SE = sqrt(var_ref/n_ref + var_alt/n_alt); interval widths compared
crn_experiment.method: PAIRED CRN (production) vs INDEPENDENT-SEED (evaluation helper only; engine untouched)

eligible_state_source: exact-anchor reconstruction (RaceStateReconstructor) + prepare_initial_state (no status resolver; matches strategy product path conservatism)

layer2.states: first 8 eligible in canonical (race_id, state_time_s) order

magnitude_bands.note: descriptive reporting bands frozen a priori; primary analysis uses quantiles

plausibility_classes.PATHOLOGICAL: impossible positions, out-of-bounds probabilities, invalid action with metrics, distribution not summing to 1, demonstrable leakage
plausibility_classes.PLAUSIBLE: no pathology flags; behavior interpretable under frozen mechanics
plausibility_classes.QUESTIONABLE: anomaly short of pathology; flagged for E evidence

race_sampling_rule: all 149 served races; no race excluded except via eligibility

REFINEMENT_WARRANTED_iff_any: paired CRN systematically worse than independent (median width ratio > 1.05 AND sign-flip rate > 20%)
systematic unsupported misclassification (eligible states refused with codes contradicting frozen taxonomy)

seeds_experiment.subset: first 6 eligible Layer-1 states in canonical order

stage_definitions: raceintel/model_lab/stages.py stage_partition on leader_laps_done/scheduled_laps: EARLY [0,1/3), MID [1/3,2/3), LATE [2/3,1]

v35_diagnostic.join: (race_id, target_driver_id, decision_lap) -> data/v3/v3_5c/oof_D{1,2,3}.parquet model==l2_logistic proj_is_top1 (frozen champion transform for Top1: RAW->PAVA)
v35_diagnostic.reference: MC2 no-intervention win frequency (Layer-2 5000-run; Layer-1 200-run with caveat)
